keyVerseDR: "The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath." (Mk 2:27)

level1.title: A Day for God
level1.story: On the sabbath, Jesus' friends picked grain to eat. Jesus said, "The sabbath was made for people." Then He healed a man's hand on the sabbath.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What do you do on Sundays?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me keep Sunday holy. Amen.

activity.title: Keep holy the Lord's Day
activity.intro: Color a heart each Sunday you go to Mass and do good.

level2.title: Lord of the Sabbath
level2.story: On the sabbath, Jesus' disciples began to pluck ears of corn as they walked. The Pharisees asked why they did what was not lawful on the sabbath. Jesus said, "The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath." In the synagogue there was a man with a withered hand. Jesus asked, "Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil?" and He said, "Stretch forth thy hand," and it was healed.
level2.keyLine: The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How can your family make Sunday special?
actions: Do a good deed on Sunday
level2.prayer: Lord of the Sabbath, make my Sundays holy. Amen.

activity.title: Mass postures
activity.intro: Sunday is the Lord's Day! Match each part of Mass to our posture.

art.mainBrief: Jesus healing a man's hand in synagogue on the Sabbath
